read_middlebury_flow: read a Middlebury .FLO optical flow file and return width, height, u, v, and mask arrays
read_kitti_flow: read a KITTI-2015 16-bit PNG optical flow file and return width, height, u, v, and mask arrays
write_middlebury_flow: write u and v flow fields to a Middlebury .FLO file with optional validity mask
convert_flow_formats: convert optical flow data between Middlebury .FLO and KITTI PNG formats
load_camera_calibration: load KITTI cam-to-cam calibration file and return camera intrinsics and baseline values
